metaTitle: Custom Beach Mats with Zipper | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom beach mats with zipper for easy storage. Perfect for giveaways and events. Bulk pricing from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom beach mats with zipper offer a practical advantage over open-roll mats: they fold into a compact, zippered pouch for sand-free storage and easy transport. Marketing directors and event planners choose this style to give recipients a branded mat that stays clean in the car or backpack. Decorate the outer fabric with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a polished, functional giveaway that stands out at company picnics, beach cleanups, or summer trade shows.
heroAltText: Custom beach mats with zipper featuring a branded logo, folded into a zippered pouch for easy storage
